# Travel Documentation Instructions

Apply these rules when editing markdown content in this repository.

- Keep the writing consistent with the existing project voice: warm, adventurous, and clear.
- Ensure each page fits the surrounding documentation structure.
- Keep markdown formatting simple and readable.
- Do not add unsupported travel claims, pricing, or itineraries.
- Maintain valid relative links and preserve any image references.
- Prefer concise improvements that match the repository’s existing tone.
